skill.name: linkedin-easy-apply
skill.description: Automate LinkedIn Easy Apply searches and applications with Puppeteer, resume upload, role filters, state tracking, and conservative answer rules.
skill.summary: Automates filtered LinkedIn Easy Apply workflows with resume upload, verified answers, and state tracking.
skill.author: ralyodio

security_audit.summary: Most shell-backtick detections are false positives caused by Markdown fences and inline code. Confirmed risks include sandbox-disabled Chromium, persistent browser session storage, /tmp state logs, and automated personal data submission. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration instructions were found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove --no-sandbox and --disable-setuid-sandbox when possible. Use a sandboxed browser or an isolated container for automation.

remediation.issue: Persistent Chrome profile can retain session cookies.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated browser profile with restricted permissions. Do not reuse a primary personal browser profile.

remediation.issue: State and logs are stored under /tmp.
remediation.suggestion: Store state in a private user directory with owner-only permissions. Avoid logging personal contact details or resume contents.

remediation.issue: The workflow can submit applications automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Require operator review before final submission and document compliance with LinkedIn rules and rate limits.

content.value_statement: Manual LinkedIn Easy Apply searches can be repetitive and inconsistent. This skill guides agents through a controlled Puppeteer workflow with filters, resume checks, and skip rules.
actual_capabilities: Builds LinkedIn Jobs searches with Easy Apply, location, remote, and keyword filters.
Launches Puppeteer with Chromium and a persistent browser profile for manual login reuse.
Opens direct Easy Apply URLs when a LinkedIn job ID is available.
Uploads or selects a verified resume PDF during supported application flows.
Fills only resume-backed or operator-approved answers and skips unknown required fields.
Writes submitted, skipped, and already-submitted state for repeat daily runs.
limitations: Requires the operator to log in to LinkedIn manually through the browser profile.
Must stop for CAPTCHA, MFA, identity checks, and suspicious-login prompts.
Does not answer compensation, essay, relocation, or unclear required questions without approval.
Can break when LinkedIn changes page structure, modals, or form behavior.

use_cases.title: Run a Focused Remote Job Search
use_cases.description: Search Easy Apply roles with remote-only and keyword filters, then submit only safe matches.

use_cases.title: Track Daily Application Progress
use_cases.description: Reuse state files to avoid duplicate applications and report submitted or skipped roles.

use_cases.title: Test Application Automation Rules
use_cases.description: Validate resume-backed answer rules and skip behavior before enabling real submissions.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up a Dry Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the LinkedIn Easy Apply skill in dry-run mode. Configure my resume path, target keywords, location, and maximum scan count. Do not submit applications.

prompt_templates.title: Search Remote AI Roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search LinkedIn Easy Apply for remote AI, LLM, and software engineer roles in the United States. Skip hybrid roles and any unclear required questions.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Submitting
prompt_templates.prompt: Find matching Easy Apply roles and prepare each application with verified resume facts. Pause before final submission and show why each role is safe to submit.

prompt_templates.title: Resume Daily Automation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced repeat run with state tracking.
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume yesterday's LinkedIn Easy Apply run from the state file. Avoid duplicates, respect the apply limit, and report submitted, skipped, and already-submitted roles.

output_examples.input: Run a dry search for remote Codex and LLM engineer roles.
output: Scanned 40 Easy Apply roles matching the requested keywords.
Prepared 6 possible applications for review and submitted none because dry run was enabled.
Skipped 12 roles because the full description required hybrid work or unclear answers.

output_examples.input: Apply to safe matches and stop before any compensation question.
output: Submitted 3 applications with verified resume facts.
Skipped 2 applications because compensation or custom essay fields were required.
Saved state so the next run can avoid duplicates.

output_examples.input: Resume the daily run and summarize results.
output_examples.output: The run skipped already-submitted roles, applied to safe matches, and reported each skipped role with a reason.

best_practices: Start with dry-run mode and review every prepared application before enabling submission.
Use a dedicated browser profile and keep LinkedIn credentials out of scripts and logs.
Keep role keywords narrow and verify full job descriptions before applying.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse a primary personal browser profile for automation runs.
Do not fabricate applicant facts or infer approval from generic page text.
Do not submit applications when required fields are unclear or subjective.

faq.question: Does this skill store LinkedIn credentials?
faq.answer: No. It recommends manual login through a browser profile and warns against storing credentials in scripts or logs.

faq.question: Can it submit applications automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, but only when the workflow finds no unknown required fields. Operator review is still the safer default.

faq.question: Does it support remote-only searches?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes remote-only filtering and rechecks full job descriptions for hybrid or location constraints.

faq.question: What happens with CAPTCHA or MFA?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the agent to stop for CAPTCHA, MFA, identity checks, and suspicious-login prompts.

faq.question: Can it answer custom essay questions?
faq.answer: No. It skips custom essays, cover-letter prompts, compensation questions, and unclear required inputs unless approved.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
